text:
eve (PM): heads-up: late request from a pilot customer asking for tenant-specific rate limits. tradeoff: adds infra work and changes rollout. can we scope a minimal MVP approach?

kai (Eng): full tenant rate-limits require per-tenant token buckets + storage + billing hooks. 3 sprints. minimal: global rate limits + an ops-managed exception list (whitelist) stored in k/v. low effort ~1w.

mona (Design): UX: console shouldn't expose tenant rate controls in MVP. show a banner noting managed exceptions and link to support.

raj (Data): telemetry: even if we do ops exceptions, emit tenant-id on rate metrics so we can retroactively attribute usage. add a monitoring rule for spikes.

tara (Support): managed exceptions OK, but we need a playbook and an SLA for changes. I'll draft a template for requests and include expected lead time.

eve (PM): proposal: MVP = global rate limits + ops-managed exception list for up to 3 pilot tenants; v1 = per-tenant rate controls in console + billing integration. Action items:
- eve: update milestone tracker & notify pilot customer (today)
- kai: implement ops-exception k/v + emit tenant-id in metrics (1w)
- raj: create alerting rules for tenant spikes (this sprint)
- mona: banner copy + support link (EOD)
- tara: support playbook + SLA template (Mon)

ciabot: note: feature-flag "tenant-rate-v1" toggled OFF for MVP

eve (PM): if no objections, locking MVP cut for tenant-rate to ops-exceptions only. objections by EOD.
